LanguageData.CC_Settings_EventCards_Tip: Rimfolk's letters (its questions for the council, the council's meetings, its events and the world's, other peoples' offers and asks, the camps', the colony's news and every other letter it sends) open as a card in Rimfolk's own look: a picture of who or what it is about, its title and kind, the text, each answer as a card of its own with what it does and what it costs or risks, who is involved with their mood and heart, and what the council leans to where it voted. They still arrive on the right as the game's letters do, with the same sound and colour, and are put off, answered or dismissed the same way; only the window that opens is Rimfolk's. The game's own letters and other mods' stay as they are. Needs Rimfolk's own look; off, the game's letter window.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_EventCards: Rimfolk's letters open as cards: a picture, the text, each answer as its own card, who is involved.
